author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam takes us a trip down memory lane to his formative years building, modding, and repairing bicycles in New York. The importance of bicycles to Adam's early days as a young tinkerer and engineer comes back to him as he rebuilds the same model 1980s Cannondale SR500 road bike that was the beloved bike of his youth. 

Shot by Adam Savage and edited by Joey Fameli
Music by Jinglepunks
